headline: MacBook Pro's new touchscreen display divides reviewers
summary: Reviewers agree the new MacBook Pro's OLED/PROLED XDR touchscreen display costs significantly more and, per Tom's Hardware and Engadget, makes the laptop lighter. But they split on whether the touchscreen itself is a meaningful upgrade: Tom's Hardware calls it a major improvement, while Engadget says it doesn't add much.
